name: Casillas (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, the white charged with a red house at the hoist.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 14 August 1998 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 215 of 8 September 1998); the flag is rectangular of 2:3 formed of two equal vertical stripes, white with a red house next to the staff and blue at the fly.
